name: Ryttylä Station
description: A yellow wooden station from 1863. Nobody has sold tickets here since the eighties, but the R train still stops on its way to Helsinki.
greeting: The R train to Helsinki is three minutes late.
Kids are doing tricks at the skate ramp.
A commuter in a suit sighs at the timetable.
The underpass smells faintly of spray paint.

hello: The 7:42 was late again. Wrote it down.
In my day this station had a stationmaster.
Sit down, the bench is warm.
Did you know this station opened in 1863?
work: Off to the big city again? Good for you.
Back from Helsinki. You look tired.
day_trip: Bring me a doughnut from the market square!
broke: Train tickets aren't free, you know.
Not enough for the ticket? Happens.

lines: A pigeon eyes your sandwich. You have no sandwich. It eyes you anyway.
This pigeon has waited for the R train longer than anyone. It never gets on.
Kurr kurr. The pigeon is not impressed by your career choices.

actions.label: Day trip to Helsinki
actions.description: Market square, museums and a bowl of salmon soup.

then.message: A second trip to the city this week. The R train is late both ways and the same seagull is waiting for you.

do.message: A great day in the capital. A seagull stole your doughnut.
Market square, a museum and salmon soup in the old market hall.
You ride the ferry to Suomenlinna and back. The sea wind clears your head.
